QUOTE: "`ExternalBridge::run_async_ask` (`:1158`) | Detached worker that runs `entropic_run` for `entropic.ask` | **Detached** (`.detach()` at `:1222`)" and "`stop()` joins only the accept and client threads, not the async workers."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the async-ask worker as the detached thread (all others are joined) and notes that it has no join, so it can outlive the bridge.
